title: AGI arrives as an uneven profile, not a clean threshold
statement: There will be no identifiable moment or system that counts as 'AGI arrives.' Systems will show superhuman performance in some capacities (synthesis, coding, exam tasks) while remaining unreliable at long-horizon agency, physical-world grounding, and self-knowledge of when they are wrong. Public debate will keep treating it as binary; the reality will remain a gradient through at least 2030.
falsifier:
A broadly accepted benchmark or event by which the field itself dates 'AGI achieved' as a clean threshold — e.g., a system passing a pre-registered cross-domain test suite with consensus from major labs that the AGI line has been crossed.

[Provenance] [2026-09-10] confidence_score normalized from 0.75 (0-1 scale) to 75 (0-100 canonical scale) on 2026-09-18; value unchanged in meaning, scale only.
